items.title: Overview - Folk Developer Portal
items.snippet:
folk exposes a REST API that is organized around predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts and returns JSON-encoded payloads, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs.
[...]
The base URL for the API is
[...]
```
https://api.folk.app

```
[...]
All API requests must be made over HTTPS. Calls made over plain HTTP will fail.

items.title: Getting started | Stage
items.snippet:
# Getting started
[...]
- You have Stage v1.0.0 or higher installed.
- You have Node.js 16.10 or higher installed. We recommend nvm to install Node.
[...]
- You have npm 7.0 or higher installed. If you used nvm to install Node, this is the case.
[...]
- You are familiar with React and TypeScript. Don't worry, you don't need to be an expert. If you need some help with the basics, check out TypeScript's Handbook and React's Getting Started guide.
[...]
```shell
npm i -g stage
[...]
With the Stage CLI installed, you are now well prepared to start developing extensions.

items.title: STAGEPAGE – The website builder made for performers.
items.snippet:
STAGEPAGE – The website builder made for performers.
[...]
The website software built for performers. Get a custom, standout website designed for you, running entirely on StagePage. We do the pro design and tech setup for you. You just log in and manage your career.
[...]
## Built exclusively for the stage. Designed completely for you.
[...]
We got tired of clunky website builders, so we built our own software from the ground up, just for performers. And we completely eliminated the learning curve because you don't have to do the initial setup and design. We do it for you.
[...]
Update your entire career in 5 minutes without ever fighting a drag-and-drop designer. Just log into your StagePage Studio.
[...]
We handle the pro design and all of the tech stuff. You just look like a star.
[...]
We don't build on those platforms - StagePage replaces them with a better option.
[...]
For roughly the exact same price, you can migrate over to the StagePage software and get a complete, professional design refresh. Stop paying top dollar for tools built for local plumbers and bakeries.
[...]
Send us the link to your current site, and we will do the heavy lifting of migrating everything over. Do you like your current website design and don't want to leave it behind? We can recreate it on StagePage.
[...]
Choose a time on our calendar for a quick, 20-minute strategy session to confirm your design vibe and career goals. Once we decide we're a perfect fit, we’ll send over your invoice and unlock your secure "Asset Vault" so you can upload your headshots, reels, and resume.
[...]
We meet live on Zoom for
[...]
Once you give us the final green light, we take care of all the heavy tech lifting. We set up the premium hosting, do all of the technical work that you don't want to do, secure the site, connect your custom domain and hand you the keys to your StagePage Studio so you are ready to go.
[...]
Stop paying for generic tools that are not built for you and make your life harder. Review our pricing before your Strategy Call.
